form.message: Project Fulcrum — Gate 1. Requirements validation passed and the independent comprehensive review is APPROVED with 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix and 0 suggestions. Approve only the documented fictional-data, infrastructure-only dev requirements and scope. Strict Sweden Central-only feasibility, private access, policy and other later prerequisites remain unresolved; this is not architecture/compliance approval or Azure, spend, Production or deployment authority. Choose whether to proceed, revise or stop. For a revision, include the requested change in your custom response.

gate1_decision.title: Project Fulcrum — requirements approval and next action
gate1_decision.description: A separate human decision is required. No option is preselected. Approval plus continuation authorizes the parent to complete Step 1 and run 03-Architect, not to perform Azure operations.
enumNames: Approve and continue — complete Step 1 and run 03-Architect
Approve and pause — complete Step 1 and pause before Architecture work
Revise — specify the requirements change in your response
Stop — do not complete or continue

answers.current_delivery_scope: New dev-only hosting-platform MVP; first usable infrastructure within two weeks. Future Production is outside this delivery.
answers.current_delivery_data_constraint: Development uses fictional data only. Mandatory security/privacy baseline applies in dev; future Production GDPR requirement remains outside this dev delivery, with no compliance certification.
answers.authorized_current_activity: Bounded Step 1 requirements discovery, anonymous documentation, validation and the required independent review through the interactive parent. No Azure reads or writes, credential operations, deployment, infrastructure code, application scaffolding, commits or pushes are authorized.

parent_action: Validate current review and forward only form.message/form.requestedSchema to native ask_user, retaining context and this local request ID separately. Record the actual human response separately. Cancellation stops; decline or ambiguous custom text does not approve. Only the parent may complete or transition Step 1 after evidenced approval. A revise response requires affected-input validation and review within the existing cycle, not an allowance reset.
